method: Whole1551-line Rust bridge read in three contiguous ranges; six other files whole read. Original preview helpers extracted unchanged except removing Windows cfg, compiled standalone with rustc; owned in-memory data only.
findings: Original ANSI preview uses UTF8-lossy decode, not Windows active codepage; byte E9 becomes replacement in executed control. C++ content-search ANSI path instead uses CP_ACP: search/preview encoding policies differ.

Original case-insensitive preview computes character offset in lowercased string, then indexes original characters; expanding lowercase İ shifts offset. Query a in İxay selects y. Ordinary Cyrillic case-insensitive and basic preview controls pass. No browser screenshot/highlighting run.

Rust FFI copies C strings then frees through C++ before deserializing; invalid JSON returns explicit error. Search cancellation C++ [] payload becomes Ok(empty), no cancellation distinction added by bridge.

Duplicate default is50MiB when omitted; explicit0 becomes1MiB in C++ rather than including empty files. Bridge adds no snapshot provenance, per-file skipped-error inventory or truncated-group metadata.

delete_path default recycle_bin false if caller omits both aliases. UI caller policy remains unreviewed. Rename uses fs::rename without direct index update; single-drive live journal is expected to reconcile, but multi-drive/fallback mode lacks watcher. No deletion/rename executed.

Text preview is bounded4MiB+1 and records byte truncation; binary preview metadata limit checked before unbounded fs::read of reopened path, so concurrent growth/replacement may exceed intended bound. Static race hypothesis, no real file mutation.

Android test sources assert2+2, package name, app-name string(previous review), and render constant OmniSearch Test text to a screenshot. TestURI only prints URI components. None of these establishes dedup/scan correctness. Screenshot asset not yet visually inspected.
Build compiles scanner only for Windows, requests C++20 and EHsc, and invokes Tauri build. No native matcher test command present in these build/manifests; repository-wide test absence not claimed.
Preview Unicode/encoding weaknesses are upstream findings, not demonstrated rrrah defects. No upstream code adopted.
